_description: Perfect positive stock/bond correlation with matched volatility. The two lognormal return streams are fully coupled (rho = 1, matched sigma) so the portfolio behaves as a single asset with 10% stddev. Final-balance dispersion is at its maximum for this stddev.
_rationale: Same 50/50 portfolio as correlation-perfect-negative but with rho = 1. Portfolio yearly log-return variance equals the common asset variance (sigma^2/2 * (1 + rho) = sigma^2). Over 10 years the median tracks 500000 * exp(mu_ln * 10) where mu_ln ≈ ln(1.05) - 0.00451 ≈ 0.04428, so median ≈ 778000. With substantial per-run dispersion the seeded median may land anywhere from ~600k to ~1M. Wide acceptance range — the purpose of this scenario is to confirm the run succeeds under maximal correlation, not to pin a specific number.
name: Correlation: Perfect Positive
